# Task curation fixtures

The `.tar.gz` archives preserve representative CodeNet, TaskTrove math and TaskTrove multi-turn challenge tasks for conversion and grader tests. [`nemotron_ultra/`](nemotron_ultra/README.md) holds JSON rows for Ultra components with unusual grading data. Tests load these files as local inputs; they do not stand in for a complete source sample.

See the [test directory](../README.md) for the suites that use these fixtures.
